 By Lance Wilhelm, WRAL reporter
 The Green Level High School marching band will be competing in the Bands of America Grand National Championships. They left Thursday at 8 a.m.
 The championship began Thursday and runs through Saturday at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana. 
 Other WRAL Top Stories
 Green Level will perform on Friday at 5:45pm. It is the only North Carolina band represented in this year's competition.
 The band -- which has 170 members -- made history last month at Western Carolina University's Tournament of Champions. They became the first band from North Carolina in the competition's 25-year history to earn both first place in the state and first place overall, the band told WRAL in a statement.
  The Grand National Championships will mark the band's final performance of its 2026 show, "Poison Posies," this season.
